lines: Perfect day. Healthy food. A long walk.
Next morning: up one point two kilos.
Before you quit: that's not fat.
Your weight moves one to two kilos a day, from water, salt and food still in you.
A kilo of fat is about seven and a half thousand calories. You didn't eat that yesterday.
Weigh in daily if you like, but only trust the weekly average.
The line under the noise is the real one.
Send this to the friend who quit because of one morning.
Do you weigh yourself every day?
